backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user profile management and product CRUD operations with role-based access control (admin/user permissions) and default product population.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two high-confidence features: fixing jsPDF initialization failures and improving PDF generation error handling with clear feedback.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of frontend TypeScript/React files covering product types, PDF/ZIP generation, validation, UI components, and error handling with jsPDF availability checks.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining light and dark theme color palettes for UI components including sidebar, cards, and charts.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading jsPDF and JSZip libraries from CDN and mounting the React application at #root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component managing authentication flow, profile setup, view routing (editor/export/preview/storefront), and onboarding instructions with loading states.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Internet Identity login/logout button component with loading states, error handling, and dynamic accessibility labels.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for first-time user profile setup requiring name input with enhanced styling and form submission handling.
frontend/src/components/errors/GlobalErr: React error boundary component catching unhandled errors and displaying a user-friendly reload interface with optional development error details.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportIns: Displays comprehensive tabbed instructions for using the app, including steps for signing in, customizing products, generating exports, and selling on Gumroad and Etsy.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportScr: Provides UI for downloading generated product bundles individually (PDF/ZIP) or all together, with file size display and error handling.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main application layout component with header, navigation buttons (Instructions, Export, Preview, Storefront), and authentication status display.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/Onboa: Modal dialog wrapper that displays the ExportInstructions component for onboarding new users.
frontend/src/components/preview/PdfPrevi: Renders an iframe preview of a generated PDF blob with fallback message when no PDF is available.
frontend/src/components/preview/UnifiedP: Displays a grid of all three products with cover images, expandable descriptions, and embedded PDF previews for each generated bundle.
frontend/src/components/preview/ZipConte: Shows a scrollable tree view of files and folders that will be included in a product's ZIP download.
frontend/src/components/products/Product: React component that provides a tabbed form interface for editing product details including basic info, modules, prompts, and resources with add/remove functionality for dynamic lists.
Main workspace component that manages multiple product entries with local draft persistence, backend synchronization, and orchestrates product bundle generation with validation and error handling.
frontend/src/components/storefront/Store: Card component displaying a single product with cover image, expandable description, and edit button with hover effects and responsive layout.
Storefront view that displays a grid of all default products using StorefrontProductCard components with navigation back to the editor.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, handling actor initialization and query invalidation on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendProducts.ts: Hook that fetches the three default products from the backend by their IDs using the actor, with loading states and error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnboardingInstruct: Hook managing onboarding modal visibility state with localStorage persistence to track whether instructions have been seen and provide manual open/close controls.
frontend/src/hooks/usePopulateDefaultPro: Provides hooks to check admin status and populate default products in the backend, with query invalidation on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Hooks for fetching and saving user profile data via the backend actor with React Query caching and automatic invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for light/dark theme colors, spacing, and a workspace container utility with a gradient top accent.
frontend/src/lib/assets/covers.ts: Exports product cover image paths and provides utility functions to retrieve cover paths and fetch cover images as Blobs for three predefined products.
frontend/src/lib/defaultProducts.ts: Defines default product data for three digital products (Digital Planner Mastery, Canva Templates Empire, and one truncated) with modules, prompts, templates, and checklists.
frontend/src/lib/downloads.ts: Provides utility functions to trigger browser downloads for Blob objects and File objects by creating temporary object URLs and programmatically clicking anchor elements.
frontend/src/lib/filename.ts: Exports functions to slugify text and generate safe, versioned filenames for product PDFs, ZIPs, and complete bundle archives with date-based versioning.
frontend/src/lib/generation/formatGenera: Formats generation and validation errors into user-friendly English messages with product context, and provides a logging function for detailed error diagnostics.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateAllB: Orchestrates generation of PDF and ZIP bundles for multiple products sequentially, reporting progress via an optional callback function.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateProd: Generates a complete bundle (PDF and ZIP) for a single product by loading the cover image, generating the PDF, and packaging it into a ZIP file with comprehensive error handling.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generationEr: Defines a typed GenerationError class that captures the generation step (library-check, cover, pdf, zip), product context, and original error for structured error handling.
frontend/src/lib/generation/productDataE: Defines a ProductDataValidationError class for capturing product validation failures with product context, missing field names, and a diagnostic snapshot.
frontend/src/lib/localDrafts.ts: Manages localStorage persistence for product drafts with versioning, providing functions to load, save, and reset draft data with version mismatch handling.
Generates a PDF document for a product entry using jsPDF, validating required fields, adding cover image if available, and rendering product details including modules, prompts, templates, and checklists (truncated).
frontend/src/lib/pdf/jspdfClient.ts: Wrapper module for jsPDF loaded from CDN, providing functions to check availability, get the jsPDF constructor from window.jspdf.jsPDF, and create PDF documents with error handling.
frontend/src/lib/products/mapBackendProd: Maps backend ProductDefinition objects to frontend ProductEntry objects, merging with default product data to ensure all required fields (name, subtitle, description) are present.
frontend/src/lib/validation/productValid: Validates that required product fields (name, subtitle, description) are present and non-empty, providing validation results for individual products or all products with detailed error messages.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildAllProductsZip: Creates a master ZIP file containing individual product ZIPs in separate folders, with a consolidated README including upload instructions for all products.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildProductZip.ts: Builds a product ZIP file containing the PDF, cover image, templates, checklists, prompts, and a comprehensive README with usage and upload instructions.
frontend/src/lib/zip/jszipClient.ts: Wrapper module for JSZip loaded from CDN, providing functions to get the JSZip constructor from window.JSZip and create new ZIP instances with error handling.
frontend/src/lib/zip/readmeContent.ts: Provides helper functions to generate README content sections for product ZIPs, including app usage instructions and step-by-step guides for uploading to Gumroad and Etsy marketplaces.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/types/productEntry.ts: TypeScript type definitions for ProductModule, ProductEntry with modules/prompts/templates/checklists, and GeneratedBundle containing PDF/ZIP blobs with version metadata.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from query strings or hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and functions to clear parameters from URLs.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, extended theme with sidebar/chart colors, custom animations, and typography/container-queries/animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata indicating this is a fix request for PDF library (jsPDF) initialization failure preventing PDF generation on the backend, with two existing features tracking the fix and error handling improvements.
